newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's terms of trade improved in 3rd quarter.
newsitem.headline: Israel's terms of trade improved in 3rd quarter.

text.p: Israel's terms of trade improved by 0.7 percent in the third quarter compared with the second quarter, the Central Bureau of Statistics reported on Tuesday.
It said the improvement came as the price of merchandise imports, not counting diamonds and fuel, declined 1.1 percent against a 0.4 percent drop in merchandise export prices during the three months.
Although Israel's terms of trade deteriorated 0.3 percent in the second quarter, the overall trend has changed this year after a steady deterioration in 1994 and 1995.
